Since every indicator is computed from the prices on your screen, it cannot know anything the chart doesn't already contain. The reason traders use them anyway is practical, not magical — a good indicator makes a pattern easier to see and act on consistently.

0d99e8c125f9.en: On January 15, 2015, the Swiss National Bank unexpectedly removed a floor it had defended for over three years, promising to hold EUR/CHF at 1.20 "with the utmost determination." Without warning, they abandoned it — and cut interest rates further into negative territory in the same announcement. EUR/CHF collapsed from 1.20 to as low as 0.85 within minutes. Every stop-loss order set anywhere near 1.20 triggered correctly and converted to a market order exactly as designed — but there was no buyer waiting nearby to fill them. Orders that should have closed near 1.19 or 1.15 instead filled at 0.90 or worse, if they filled at all. Alpari UK declared insolvency that same day. FXCM absorbed $225 million in client losses and needed an emergency bailout to survive. Many individual traders discovered they owed their broker more than their entire account balance, from a single trade.
0d99e8c125f9.sw: Tarehe 15 Januari 2015, Benki Kuu ya Uswisi iliondoa bila kutarajiwa sakafu iliyokuwa ikiitetea kwa zaidi ya miaka mitatu, ikiahidi kushikilia EUR/CHF kwa 1.20 "kwa uamuzi wa hali ya juu." Bila onyo, waliiacha — na kupunguza viwango vya riba zaidi hadi eneo hasi katika tangazo lile lile. EUR/CHF ilianguka kutoka 1.20 hadi chini kama 0.85 ndani ya dakika chache. Kila agizo la stop-loss lililowekwa popote karibu na 1.20 lilianzishwa kwa usahihi na kugeuka kuwa agizo la soko hasa kama lilivyoundwa — lakini hakukuwa na mnunuzi aliyesubiri karibu kulitimiza. Maagizo yaliyopaswa kufunga karibu na 1.19 au 1.15 badala yake yalitimizwa kwa 0.90 au vibaya zaidi, kama yalitimizwa kabisa. Alpari UK ilitangaza kufilisika siku hiyo hiyo. FXCM ilifyonza hasara za wateja za $225 milioni na ikahitaji uokoaji wa dharura ili kuendelea kuishi. Wafanyabiashara wengi binafsi waligundua walikuwa wanadaiwa na broker wao zaidi ya salio lote la akaunti yao, kutokana na biashara moja.

10dfe29ca4b0.en: Here's the demystifying truth: MACD is measuring how two moving averages converge and diverge — which is exactly what you just learned to see directly on the chart with the 20/50 pair. When people talk about MACD crossovers, they're talking about the same underlying event as a moving-average crossover, expressed as an oscillating line below the chart instead of two lines on it. If you understand the crossover section, you already understand MACD. Some traders prefer its presentation (the histogram makes momentum shifts visually loud); others just read the averages directly. There is no extra information in it that the moving averages don't contain.
10dfe29ca4b0.sw: Huu hapa ukweli unaoondoa fumbo: MACD inapima jinsi wastani wawili unaosogea wanavyoungana na kutengana — ambacho ndicho hasa umejifunza kuona moja kwa moja kwenye chati kwa jozi la 20/50. Watu wanapozungumzia mikatizo ya MACD, wanazungumzia tukio lile lile la msingi kama mkatizo wa wastani unaosogea, likielezwa kama mstari unaoyumba chini ya chati badala ya mistari miwili juu yake. Kama unaelewa sehemu ya mkatizo, tayari unaelewa MACD. Baadhi ya wafanyabiashara hupendelea uwasilishaji wake (histogram hufanya mabadiliko ya kasi yaonekane wazi); wengine husoma tu wastani moja kwa moja. Hakuna taarifa ya ziada ndani yake ambayo wastani unaosogea hauna.

1575dfccbc6a.en: Ghanem, Harasheh, Sbaih & Ajmal (2024), published in Cogent Business & Management — genuinely recent research — tested 497 technical trading rules across 10 currencies over 22 years (2000–2022). Technical trading rules significantly predicted price movements in both developed and emerging-market currencies, with emerging markets showing even higher predictability.

Kanuni za biashara za kiufundi zilitabiri msogeo wa bei kwa kiasi kikubwa katika sarafu za nchi zilizoendelea na za masoko yanayoibukia, ambapo masoko yanayoibukia yalionyesha utabirikaji wa juu zaidi.

16aba5e87987.en: These two families make opposite bets. A mean-reversion tool in a strong trend loses repeatedly ("it's stretched!" — it stretches further). A trend-following tool in a sideways market whipsaws to death. Neither tool is broken in those moments — it's being asked the wrong question. Diagnosing which kind of market you're in is the judgment that sits above every indicator, and no indicator can make it for you — which is exactly where this chapter goes next.
16aba5e87987.sw: Familia hizi mbili hufanya mabashiri ya kinyume. Zana ya kurudi kwa wastani katika mwelekeo mkali hupoteza mara kwa mara ("imenyooshwa!" — inanyooka zaidi). Zana ya kufuata mwelekeo katika soko la kando hujipiga whipsaw hadi kufa. Hakuna zana iliyoharibika katika nyakati hizo — inaulizwa swali lisilo sahihi. Kubaini ni aina gani ya soko uliomo ndiyo hukumu inayokaa juu ya kila kiashiria, na hakuna kiashiria kinachoweza kuifanya kwa niaba yako — ambako ndiko hasa sura hii inakoenda baadaye.

188b61339ed1.en: Two academic studies looked at whether Bitcoin is a safe haven for stock portfolios. One (Journal of Central Banking Theory and Practice, 2026) found Bitcoin showed statistically significant negative correlation with the S&P 500 — a real candidate for safe-haven status. Another found Bitcoin's correlation with stocks rose from roughly 0.05 in 2017 to 0.25–0.30 by 2021, and concluded crypto behaves as a diversifier, not a safe haven. Both studies used real data and careful methods. They still disagree — a sign the underlying relationship genuinely shifts over time.
188b61339ed1.sw: Tafiti mbili za kitaaluma zilichunguza kama Bitcoin ni kimbilio salama kwa mikusanyiko ya hisa. Moja (Journal of Central Banking Theory and Practice, 2026) iligundua Bitcoin ilionyesha uwiano hasi wenye maana kitakwimu na S&P 500 — mgombea halisi wa hadhi ya kimbilio salama. Nyingine iligundua uwiano wa Bitcoin na hisa ulipanda kutoka takriban 0.05 mwaka 2017 hadi 0.25–0.30 kufikia 2021, na ikahitimisha kwamba crypto hutenda kama msambazaji, si kimbilio salama. Tafiti zote mbili zilitumia data halisi na mbinu makini. Bado hazikubaliani — ishara kwamba uhusiano wa msingi hubadilika kweli kwa muda.

18b529de96e7.en: This is the answer to the question this whole course has been building toward: forex exists specifically because currencies are no longer fixed to gold or each other. They float, they move — and where there's constant, unpredictable movement in something valuable, a market emerges to trade it. That market is the one you're learning to navigate.
18b529de96e7.sw: Hili ndilo jibu la swali ambalo kozi hii nzima imekuwa ikilielekea: forex ipo mahususi kwa sababu sarafu hazifungwi tena kwenye dhahabu wala kwa kila mmoja. Zinaelea, zinasogea — na palipo na msogeo wa kudumu usiotabirika katika kitu chenye thamani, soko hujitokeza kukifanyia biashara. Soko hilo ndilo unalojifunza kulipitia.

1a2a630b54bc.en: The 100,000-unit standard lot isn't an arbitrary round number — it reflects the historical scale of interbank trading, where banks moved large sums to settle international trade, long before individual retail traders had any access to the market. Mini, micro, and nano lots were introduced later specifically to make the market accessible to smaller accounts.
1a2a630b54bc.sw: Lot sanifu ya vipimo 100,000 si namba ya mviringo ya bahati nasibu — inaakisi ukubwa wa kihistoria wa biashara kati ya benki, ambapo benki zilihamisha kiasi kikubwa kulipia biashara ya kimataifa, muda mrefu kabla wafanyabiashara binafsi wa rejareja hawajapata ufikiaji wowote wa soko. Lot ndogo, ndogo sana, na za nano zilianzishwa baadaye mahususi ili kufanya soko lipatikane kwa akaunti ndogo.

1a62a3dd926e.en: For most of human history — over 6,000 years — barter was how people exchanged what they had for what they needed: trading goods or services directly, with no money involved. It worked, but it had one serious flaw.
1a62a3dd926e.sw: Kwa sehemu kubwa ya historia ya binadamu — zaidi ya miaka 6,000 — kubadilishana bidhaa ndiyo ilivyokuwa njia ya watu kubadilishana walichokuwa nacho kwa walichohitaji: kubadilishana bidhaa au huduma moja kwa moja, bila pesa. Ilifanya kazi, lakini ilikuwa na kasoro moja kubwa.

1b3cc67a15df.en: You broke even — exchange rates always average out
1b3cc67a15df.sw: Ulilingana — viwango vya ubadilishaji daima hujilinganisha

1b57e542064a.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — agizo la soko hutimizwa mara moja kwa bei yoyote inayopatikana: utekelezaji wa uhakika, lakini si bei.

1c7651c5d726.sw: Kweli au Uongo: pesa lazima iwe kitu cha kimwili kilichotengenezwa kwa kitu chenye thamani, kama dhahabu, ili ifanye kazi kama pesa.

1d6f532d78ec.en: An order that sits inactive until price reaches a trigger level, at which point it becomes a market order. Once triggered, it carries a market order's guarantee: execution, not price.
1d6f532d78ec.sw: Agizo linalokaa bila kufanya kazi hadi bei ifikie kiwango cha kianzishi, wakati huo linakuwa agizo la soko. Mara linapoanzishwa, hubeba uhakika wa agizo la soko: utekelezaji, si bei.

1d7ef3cc744e.en: The bid-ask spread is a real, research-backed cost of trading — not just broker profit — and a pip is the unit you measure price moves in.
1d7ef3cc744e.sw: Spread ya bid-ask ni gharama halisi ya kufanya biashara inayoungwa mkono na utafiti — si faida ya broker tu — na pip ni kipimo unachopimia misogeo ya bei.

1d8628911d2d.en: An asset with an average positive — but imperfect — correlation to your existing holdings. Still tends to move with the rest of your portfolio, just not in lockstep.

1e6040f0fd6d.en: The disciplined version: wait for the RSI to exit the extreme zone. Price falls, RSI drops below 30 (oversold) — you wait. Only when RSI crosses back above 30 — meaning the selling pressure has actually broken — do you buy. You sacrifice a little of the move in exchange for confirmation that the reversal has actually begun, rather than betting that it will.

30a37365597f.en: Heimer & Simsek (2019), published in the Journal of Financial Economics, studied exactly this question using a natural experiment: when the US imposed its 50:1/20:1 leverage cap in 2010, the researchers compared American traders (now capped) against otherwise-similar European traders (still uncapped at the time) using a difference-in-differences approach. They found the leverage constraint reduced trading volume by 23%, and — the key result — improved high-leverage traders' portfolio returns by 18 percentage points per month, alleviating their losses by roughly 40%. Their conclusion: the trading the cap eliminated was disproportionately speculative rather than informed, meaning the restriction removed harmful activity rather than useful market participation.
30a37365597f.sw: Heimer & Simsek (2019), waliochapisha katika Journal of Financial Economics, walisoma swali hili hasa kwa kutumia jaribio la asili: Marekani ilipoweka kikomo chake cha leverage cha 50:1/20:1 mwaka 2010, watafiti walilinganisha wafanyabiashara wa Marekani (sasa wenye kikomo) dhidi ya wafanyabiashara wa Ulaya wanaofanana kwa mengine (bado bila kikomo wakati huo) kwa kutumia mbinu ya tofauti-ndani-ya-tofauti. Waligundua kikwazo cha leverage kilipunguza kiasi cha biashara kwa 23%, na — tokeo muhimu — kiliboresha faida za mikusanyiko ya wafanyabiashara wa leverage kubwa kwa pointi 18 za asilimia kwa mwezi, kikipunguza hasara zao kwa takriban 40%. Hitimisho lao: biashara ambayo kikomo kiliiondoa ilikuwa ya kubahatisha kwa kiwango kisicholingana badala ya kuwa yenye taarifa, ikimaanisha kikwazo kiliondoa shughuli yenye madhara badala ya ushiriki wa soko wenye manufaa.

3328f86d7319.en: Kelly's formula is well-proven, but it has a serious practical problem for real trading: it requires you to already know your true win rate and reward-to-risk ratio — numbers a beginner (and honestly, most traders) can't estimate reliably. Worse, "full Kelly" is aggressive enough that even with a genuine edge, it can produce 50–80% drawdowns along the way. This is precisely why professional traders and quants typically use "fractional Kelly" — a half or quarter of the full formula — trading some theoretical growth for dramatically less volatility.
3328f86d7319.sw: Fomula ya Kelly ina uthibitisho mzuri, lakini ina tatizo kubwa la kivitendo kwa biashara halisi: inakuhitaji ujue tayari kiwango chako halisi cha ushindi na uwiano wa tuzo-kwa-hatari — namba ambazo anayeanza (na kwa uaminifu, wafanyabiashara wengi) hawawezi kuzikadiria kwa kutegemewa. Vibaya zaidi, "Kelly kamili" ni ya ukali wa kutosha kiasi kwamba hata ukiwa na faida halisi, inaweza kuzalisha kushuka kwa 50–80% njiani. Hii ndiyo hasa sababu wafanyabiashara wa kitaaluma na wataalamu wa hesabu kwa kawaida hutumia "Kelly ya sehemu" — nusu au robo ya fomula kamili, wakibadilisha ukuaji fulani wa kinadharia kwa mtikisiko mdogo zaidi kwa kiasi kikubwa.

3852db82e35e.en: Before trading, put it into practice: check the actual current spread on the pair you're using rather than a marketing headline number, which is often a best-case minimum that doesn't hold at all hours. Compare the all-in cost (spread plus any commission), not just the quoted spread — a "0.0 pip spread" account with a large commission can cost the same as, or more than, a wider-spread account with no commission. And notice when spreads widen around news events or thin trading hours, factoring that into when you enter or exit a position.
3852db82e35e.sw: Kabla ya kufanya biashara, itekeleze: kagua spread halisi ya sasa kwenye jozi unalotumia badala ya namba ya kichwa cha habari cha matangazo, ambayo mara nyingi ni kiwango cha chini cha hali bora zaidi kisichoshikilia saa zote. Linganisha gharama ya jumla (spread pamoja na kamisheni yoyote), si spread inayonukuliwa tu — akaunti ya "spread ya pip 0.0" yenye kamisheni kubwa inaweza kugharimu sawa na, au zaidi ya, akaunti yenye spread pana isiyo na kamisheni. Na tambua spread inapopanuka wakati wa matukio ya habari au saa za biashara chache, ukizingatia hilo unapoingia au kutoka katika nafasi.

39e9770f8dc5.en: Most central banks target around 2% inflation, not 0%. Zero inflation removes a central bank's room to maneuver — it can't cut rates to fight a slowdown without risking deflation, which discourages spending and can deepen a recession. Moderate, steady inflation is the target precisely because both extremes are worse.
39e9770f8dc5.sw: Benki kuu nyingi hulenga mfumuko wa bei wa karibu 2%, si 0%. Mfumuko wa bei wa sifuri huondoa nafasi ya benki kuu ya kujimudu — haiwezi kupunguza viwango vya riba kupambana na kudorora bila kuhatarisha mporomoko wa bei, ambao hukatisha tamaa matumizi na unaweza kuzidisha mdororo. Mfumuko wa bei wa wastani na thabiti ndilo lengo hasa kwa sababu pande zote mbili za mwisho ni mbaya zaidi.

3ce12e776093.en: Crypto: Bitcoin is often called "digital gold" because its supply is capped at 21 million coins. But short-term price volatility has repeatedly overshadowed that case — an asset that can swing 10% in a day doesn't behave like a stable inflation hedge. Rising rates (the usual inflation response) also tend to pull speculative capital out of crypto, often pushing prices down exactly when the "digital gold" narrative would predict a rise.

Lakini mtikisiko wa bei wa muda mfupi umefunika hoja hiyo mara kwa mara — mali inayoweza kuyumba 10% kwa siku moja haitendi kama kinga thabiti dhidi ya mfumuko wa bei. Viwango vya riba vinavyopanda (jibu la kawaida kwa mfumuko wa bei) pia huelekea kuvuta mtaji wa kubahatisha nje ya crypto, mara nyingi zikisukuma bei chini hasa wakati simulizi ya "dhahabu ya kidijitali" ingetabiri kupanda.

3ee227ac1852.en: Yen pairs break the pattern. Because the yen has a much lower per-unit value than currencies like the dollar or euro, USD/JPY and other yen pairs are quoted to only two decimal places — so a pip there is the second decimal place (0.01), not the fourth. If USD/JPY moves from 149.50 to 150.00, that's a 50-pip move, not a 0.5-pip move. This trips up nearly every beginner at least once.

Kama USD/JPY itasogea kutoka 149.50 hadi 150.00, huo ni msogeo wa pip 50, si msogeo wa pip 0.5. Hili huwakwaza karibu kila anayeanza angalau mara moja.

In the short run, rising inflation often pushes stock prices down — a stock's value partly discounts future earnings, and higher inflation increases that discount rate, shrinking the present value of those future profits. Growth stocks, leaning more on distant future earnings, tend to suffer more than value stocks.

Hisa za ukuaji, zinazotegemea zaidi mapato ya baadaye ya mbali, huelekea kuathirika zaidi kuliko hisa za thamani.

4a22a27bd6e4.en: Kelly's original paper, "A New Interpretation of Information Rate," was published in the Bell System Technical Journal — and wasn't even primarily about gambling or trading. Kelly was extending Claude Shannon's information theory, and discovered that the same math describing optimal information transmission also describes optimal bet sizing. The formula requires knowing your real win rate and your reward-to-risk ratio precisely; given those, it tells you exactly what fraction of your capital to risk to grow fastest over time.
4a22a27bd6e4.sw: Karatasi asilia ya Kelly, "A New Interpretation of Information Rate," ilichapishwa katika Bell System Technical Journal — na haikuhusu hata kwanza kamari wala biashara. Kelly alikuwa akipanua nadharia ya taarifa ya Claude Shannon, na akagundua kwamba hisabati ile ile inayoeleza usambazaji bora wa taarifa pia inaeleza upimaji bora wa ukubwa wa dau. Fomula inahitaji kujua kiwango chako halisi cha ushindi na uwiano wako wa tuzo-kwa-hatari kwa usahihi; ukiwa na hivyo, inakuambia hasa sehemu ipi ya mtaji wako ya kuhatarisha ili kukua kwa kasi zaidi kwa muda.

4d53a246ea9a.en: In July 1944, representatives of 44 Allied nations met in Bretton Woods, New Hampshire, to design a new system: instead of every country backing its own currency with its own gold, every country would peg its currency to the U.S. dollar, and only the dollar would remain convertible to gold — at that same $35-per-ounce rate from 1934.

4efdf107e3ea.en: The window length is the whole personality of the indicator. In a short SMA (say 20 periods), each new candle is 1/20 of the data, so the line reacts quickly and hugs price. In a long SMA (say 50), each new candle is only 1/50 of the data, so the line is smoother and slower — it filters out noise at the cost of reacting late. Neither is "better"; they answer different questions: what has price done recently versus what has price done over the longer stretch.
4efdf107e3ea.sw: Urefu wa dirisha ndio tabia yote ya kiashiria. Katika SMA fupi (tuseme vipindi 20), kila mshumaa mpya ni 1/20 ya data, hivyo mstari huitikia haraka na kushikamana na bei. Katika SMA ndefu (tuseme 50), kila mshumaa mpya ni 1/50 tu ya data, hivyo mstari ni laini na wa polepole zaidi — huchuja kelele kwa gharama ya kuitikia kwa kuchelewa. Hakuna "bora"; zinajibu maswali tofauti: bei imefanya nini hivi karibuni dhidi ya bei imefanya nini kwa kipindi kirefu zaidi.

501be5ab809d.en: It's tempting to think a currency's value is fixed or "real," the way a gold coin feels real. It isn't. Every currency's value — including the ones you'll see priced elsewhere in this app — is a reflection of collective trust and expectation. That's precisely why currency values move, and why markets like this one exist at all.

617b735c7afb.en: On a 4-hour NZD/USD chart with a 20 and 50 SMA: the 20 crosses below the 50 → enter short. Price falls; the 20 eventually crosses back above → close the short at a profit, and optionally go long. But the very next long gets stopped almost immediately when a large red candle drags the 20 back below the 50 — a small, quick loss. Then another short signal, another profitable leg. This sequence — several winning trades punctuated by small whipsaw losses — is what crossover trading actually looks like.
617b735c7afb.sw: Kwenye chati ya NZD/USD ya saa 4 yenye SMA ya 20 na 50: 20 inakatiza chini ya 50 → ingia short. Bei inashuka; 20 hatimaye inakatiza tena juu → funga short kwa faida, na kwa hiari nenda long. Lakini long ile inayofuata kabisa inasimamishwa karibu mara moja mshumaa mkubwa mwekundu unapovuta 20 kurudi chini ya 50 — hasara ndogo ya haraka. Kisha ishara nyingine ya short, mguu mwingine wenye faida. Mfululizo huu — biashara kadhaa za ushindi zikiingiliwa na hasara ndogo za whipsaw — ndivyo biashara ya mkatizo inavyoonekana hasa.

62f91ef1ef76.en: This ordering isn't based on economic size or trading volume — it's rooted in history. The British pound "sat on top" of the hierarchy because sterling was the world's dominant reserve currency before the U.S. dollar took over that role. When euro trading launched on January 4, 1999, brokers initially supported both EUR/GBP and GBP/EUR quote conventions and let the market decide — EUR/GBP won out almost immediately, with the euro effectively inheriting the German mark's position in the pecking order. The convention persists today for reasons of market habit and consistency, not because it's the only logical way to write it.
62f91ef1ef76.sw: Mpangilio huu haujengwi juu ya ukubwa wa kiuchumi wala kiasi cha biashara — una mizizi katika historia. Pauni ya Uingereza "ilikaa juu" ya daraja kwa sababu sterling ilikuwa sarafu kuu ya akiba duniani kabla dola ya Marekani haijachukua nafasi hiyo. Biashara ya euro ilipoanza tarehe 4 Januari 1999, mabroker awali waliunga mkono makubaliano yote mawili ya nukuu ya EUR/GBP na GBP/EUR na kuliacha soko liamue — EUR/GBP ilishinda karibu mara moja, euro ikirithi kwa hakika nafasi ya alama ya Ujerumani katika daraja. Makubaliano yanaendelea leo kwa sababu za mazoea ya soko na uthabiti, si kwa sababu ndiyo njia pekee ya kimantiki ya kuiandika.

Kama biashara itasogea dhidi yako vya kutosha kumomonyoa mto huo, broker wako atatoa wito wa margin — na kama hutaongeza fedha, wataanza kufunga nafasi zako kiotomatiki ili kujilinda dhidi ya akaunti yako kuwa hasi.

655dc50c3abe.en: GBP/USD is "Cable" — dating to the mid-1800s, when exchange rates between London and New York were transmitted via transatlantic telegraph cable (the first successful one completed in 1866). USD/CAD is "the Loonie" — after the loon bird on Canada's one-dollar coin, introduced in 1987. AUD/USD is "the Aussie," NZD/USD is "the Kiwi," and USD/CHF is "the Swissy" — each simply shortened from the country name.

USD/CAD ni "Loonie" — kwa jina la ndege loon aliye kwenye sarafu ya dola moja ya Kanada, iliyoanzishwa mwaka 1987. AUD/USD ni "Aussie," NZD/USD ni "Kiwi," na USD/CHF ni "Swissy" — kila moja likifupishwa tu kutoka jina la nchi.

6567f9b8f693.en: You have a $10,000 account, and you've decided (per Foundations Chapter 2) to risk 1% per trade — that's $100. You're planning a trade with a 50-pip stop-loss. On a standard lot, each pip is worth $10, so you need to find the lot size where 50 pips of movement costs exactly $100. $100 ÷ 50 pips = $2 of risk per pip needed. Since a standard lot is $10 per pip, $2 ÷ $10 = 0.2 standard lots — 20,000 units, or 2 mini lots. If the trade hits your stop-loss, you lose exactly $100. Not roughly $100. Exactly $100, because you sized the position specifically to make that true.
6567f9b8f693.sw: Una akaunti ya $10,000, na umeamua (kwa mujibu wa Sura ya 2 ya Msingi) kuhatarisha 1% kwa kila biashara — hiyo ni $100. Unapanga biashara yenye stop-loss ya pip 50. Kwenye lot sanifu, kila pip ina thamani ya $10, hivyo unahitaji kupata ukubwa wa lot ambapo pip 50 za msogeo zinagharimu hasa $100. $100 ÷ pip 50 = $2 ya hatari kwa kila pip inayohitajika. Kwa kuwa lot sanifu ni $10 kwa pip, $2 ÷ $10 = lot 0.2 sanifu — vipimo 20,000, au lot 2 ndogo. Kama biashara itagonga stop-loss yako, unapoteza hasa $100. Si takriban $100. Hasa $100, kwa sababu ulipima nafasi mahususi ili kufanya hilo liwe kweli.

The U.S. dollar appeared on one side of 89% of all trades. EUR/USD remains the single largest currency pair by volume, though the Chinese yuan's share has been steadily rising — USD/CNY is now the third most-traded pair globally, ahead of GBP/USD.

8269083e6fee.en: The intuitive mean-reversion play: price touches the lower band (stretched low) → buy → exit at the middle band. Price touches the upper band (stretched high) → short → exit at the middle. Tighter bands (2 SD) give more frequent, earlier signals; wider bands (3 SD) give fewer, more extreme ones. This logic works best on instruments that genuinely oscillate around a mean — for example, currency pairs between similar, linked economies (CAD and AUD-style pairs), which tend to deviate and re-converge — and works badly on anything in a strong trend, where "stretched" just keeps stretching.

Mantiki hii hufanya kazi vizuri zaidi kwenye vyombo vinavyoyumba kweli kuzunguka wastani — kwa mfano, jozi za sarafu kati ya uchumi unaofanana na uliounganishwa (jozi za mtindo wa CAD na AUD), ambazo huelekea kupotoka na kuungana tena — na hufanya kazi vibaya kwenye chochote kilicho katika mwelekeo mkali, ambapo "kunyooshwa" kunaendelea kunyooka tu.

82c1fe1d0bb8.en: What does the evidence say? One of the most-cited academic studies of technical analysis — Brock, Lakonishok & LeBaron (1992), Journal of Finance — tested exactly these moving-average rules on nearly a century of Dow Jones data and found they showed genuine predictive ability. But the follow-up literature matters just as much: later research questioned how well those results survive transaction costs and the risk of data-snooping (testing many rules and reporting the ones that happened to work). Meanwhile the recent FX-specific study you met in Foundations Chapter 3 — Ghanem et al. (2024), 497 rules, 10 currencies, 22 years — found technical rules do significantly predict currency movements. The honest summary: crossovers are one of the few indicator families with real academic support, and also one where the support comes with genuine caveats. Use them as a tool, not a truth.
82c1fe1d0bb8.sw: Ushahidi unasema nini? Mojawapo ya tafiti za kitaaluma zinazonukuliwa zaidi za uchambuzi wa kiufundi — Brock, Lakonishok & LeBaron (1992), Journal of Finance — ilijaribu kanuni hizi hizi za wastani unaosogea kwa karibu karne moja ya data ya Dow Jones na ikagundua zilionyesha uwezo halisi wa kutabiri. Lakini fasihi iliyofuata inahusika kwa kiasi kile kile: utafiti wa baadaye ulihoji jinsi matokeo hayo yanavyonusurika gharama za miamala na hatari ya kupekua data (kujaribu kanuni nyingi na kuripoti zile zilizobahatika kufanya kazi). Wakati huo huo utafiti wa hivi karibuni mahususi wa FX uliokutana nao katika Sura ya 3 ya Msingi — Ghanem et al. (2024), kanuni 497, sarafu 10, miaka 22 — uligundua kanuni za kiufundi hutabiri kwa kiasi kikubwa misogeo ya sarafu. Muhtasari wa uaminifu: mikatizo ni mojawapo ya familia chache za viashiria zenye uungwaji mkono halisi wa kitaaluma, na pia mojawapo ambapo uungwaji mkono huo unakuja na maonyo halisi. 85d94ac53729.en: Most of the time, slippage is a minor, routine cost — a fraction of a pip here or there as prices move in the instant between your order and its execution. 9118ea020037.en: The spread isn't only about adverse selection, though — the broader research on this (often traced to work by Hans Stoll and others) identifies a few real components stacked together: order-processing costs (the genuine overhead of running the infrastructure that executes trades), inventory risk (a market maker holding currency exposure they didn't necessarily want, and pricing in the risk of holding it), and adverse selection (the Glosten-Milgrom effect above). The spread you see quoted is these forces combined into one number.

Spread unayoiona ikinukuliwa ni nguvu hizi zilizounganishwa kuwa namba moja.

a190016f876f.en: Glosten & Milgrom (1985), published in the Journal of Financial Economics, proved something genuinely counterintuitive: a positive bid-ask spread emerges even when the market maker is making zero expected profit on average. The reason is adverse selection. A market maker quoting prices to a stream of traders can't tell in advance who's trading on real information (an "informed" trader who knows something about where the price is headed) and who's just trading for ordinary reasons (an "uninformed" trader). Since informed traders systematically win at the market maker's expense, the market maker must widen the spread just to break even against that risk — even with no profit motive at all. This paper remains foundational; researchers were still directly building on and citing it in market microstructure papers as recently as 2026.
a190016f876f.sw: Glosten & Milgrom (1985), waliochapisha katika Journal of Financial Economics, walithibitisha jambo lisilotarajiwa kweli: spread chanya ya bid-ask hujitokeza hata mtengeneza-soko akiwa hapati faida yoyote inayotarajiwa kwa wastani. Sababu ni uteuzi mbaya. Mtengeneza-soko anayenukuu bei kwa mkondo wa wafanyabiashara hawezi kutambua mapema ni nani anayefanya biashara kwa taarifa halisi (mfanyabiashara "mwenye taarifa" anayejua kitu kuhusu bei inakoelekea) na ni nani anayefanya biashara kwa sababu za kawaida tu (mfanyabiashara "asiye na taarifa"). Kwa kuwa wafanyabiashara wenye taarifa hushinda kwa utaratibu kwa gharama ya mtengeneza-soko, mtengeneza-soko lazima apanue spread ili tu alingane dhidi ya hatari hiyo — hata bila lengo lolote la faida. Karatasi hii inabaki ya msingi; watafiti walikuwa bado wakijenga juu yake na kuinukuu moja kwa moja katika karatasi za muundo mdogo wa soko hivi karibuni kama mwaka 2026.

bf94f292a3fb.en: Now the evidence — because Fibonacci retracements are exactly the kind of widely-repeated claim this course has taught you to check. The research is genuinely mixed, and knowing the shape of that disagreement is more useful than either blind faith or blanket dismissal. As early as 1977, Arthur Merrill's systematic study of market swings found no reliably standard retracement level. A rigorous 2021 study in Expert Systems with Applications built an algorithm to detect retracements objectively across Dow Jones, NASDAQ, and DAX stocks and found prices do bounce at Fibonacci levels somewhat more often than at arbitrary levels — but the authors explicitly note this doesn't necessarily translate into a profitable trading strategy. And multiple reviews find that standalone Fibonacci levels perform about as well as random levels, improving only when combined with independent evidence like support/resistance or trend. The most defensible reading: Fibonacci levels work partly because thousands of traders watch the same levels and place orders there — a self-fulfilling coordination point, not market magic. Treat them as zones where a reaction is plausible and other traders are paying attention — never as a guarantee, and never as a standalone system.

Utafiti umechanganyika kweli, na kujua umbo la mgogoro huo ni la manufaa zaidi kuliko imani ya kipofu au kukataa kwa jumla. Mapema kama mwaka 1977, utafiti wa kimfumo wa Arthur Merrill wa mizunguko ya soko haukupata kiwango chochote sanifu cha kutegemewa cha kurudi nyuma. Utafiti makini wa mwaka 2021 katika Expert Systems with Applications ulijenga algoriti ya kubaini kurudi nyuma kwa lengo katika hisa za Dow Jones, NASDAQ, na DAX na ukagundua bei huruka kwenye viwango vya Fibonacci mara nyingi kidogo zaidi kuliko kwenye viwango vya bahati nasibu — lakini waandishi wanabainisha wazi kwamba hili si lazima litafsirike kuwa mkakati wa biashara wenye faida. Na mapitio kadhaa hugundua kwamba viwango vya Fibonacci vinavyosimama peke yake hufanya kazi karibu sawa na viwango vya bahati nasibu, vikiboreka tu vinapounganishwa na ushahidi huru kama msaada/upinzani au mwelekeo. Usomaji unaotetewa zaidi: viwango vya Fibonacci hufanya kazi kwa sehemu kwa sababu maelfu ya wafanyabiashara hutazama viwango vile vile na kuweka maagizo hapo — mahali pa kuratibu panapojitimiza penyewe, si uchawi wa soko. Vichukulie kama kanda ambapo mwitikio unawezekana na wafanyabiashara wengine wanazingatia — kamwe si uhakika, na kamwe si mfumo unaosimama peke yake.

c95db9d6f0c8.en: Here's the honest problem, and it's a big one: financial prices do not actually follow a bell curve. This isn't a technicality — it's one of the most important findings in the history of finance. Benoit Mandelbrot demonstrated it in 1963 ("The Variation of Certain Speculative Prices," Journal of Business 36, 394–419): real price changes have fat tails — extreme moves occur far, far more often than the normal distribution predicts. Moves the bell curve calls once-in-thousands-of-years events happen every few years. You've already met the perfect example: the 2015 EUR/CHF collapse from Chapter 1, Lesson 7 — a move so far outside the bands that the clean "95% containment" math becomes meaningless. Practical consequence: price will pierce your bands more often than the statistics imply, sometimes violently. Bollinger Bands remain a genuinely useful volatility-adaptive tool — but never size a position as if the 95% figure were literally true.
c95db9d6f0c8.sw: Hili hapa tatizo la uaminifu, na ni kubwa: bei za kifedha kwa kweli hazifuati mkunjo wa kengele. Hii si suala la kiufundi — ni mojawapo ya matokeo muhimu zaidi katika historia ya fedha. Benoit Mandelbrot alilionyesha mwaka 1963 ("The Variation of Certain Speculative Prices," Journal of Business 36, 394–419): mabadiliko halisi ya bei yana mikia minene — misogeo ya kupindukia hutokea mara nyingi zaidi, zaidi sana, kuliko mtawanyiko wa kawaida unavyotabiri. Misogeo ambayo mkunjo wa kengele huiita matukio ya mara moja katika maelfu ya miaka hutokea kila baada ya miaka michache. Tayari umekutana na mfano kamili: kuanguka kwa EUR/CHF kwa mwaka 2015 kutoka Sura ya 1, Somo la 7 — msogeo ulio nje mno ya kanda kiasi kwamba hisabati safi ya "kubeba 95%" inakuwa isiyo na maana. Matokeo ya kivitendo: bei itapenya kanda zako mara nyingi zaidi kuliko takwimu zinavyodokeza, wakati mwingine kwa nguvu. Bollinger Bands zinabaki zana yenye manufaa kweli inayojirekebisha kwa mtikisiko — lakini kamwe usipime nafasi kana kwamba takwimu ya 95% ni kweli kihalisi.

Tumia hilo kwa bei 20 za mwisho za kufunga, na kanda kwa ±2 za mkengeuko sanifu "zinapaswa" kubeba takriban 95% ya shughuli ya bei — hivyo kugusa kanda ya nje kunaashiria bei imenyooshwa kitakwimu.

d5fe92f81827.en: There are hundreds of indicators, and anyone can invent a new one — many are redundant or worthless. Piling many onto one chart doesn't add insight; it adds conflict. This mirrors a general principle from statistics: adding more and more weakly-informative variables to a prediction degrades it rather than improving it. Pick a small number of tools you genuinely understand. Fifteen out of twenty indicators "agreeing" means far less than it sounds like — many are computing near-identical things from the same prices.

Hii inaakisi kanuni ya jumla kutoka takwimu: kuongeza vigezo vingi zaidi visivyo na taarifa nyingi kwenye utabiri hukudhoofisha badala ya kukuboresha. Chagua idadi ndogo ya zana unazozielewa kweli. da37d0ef7dd0.en: The single most important RSI discipline — and the mistake that costs beginners the most: do not buy simply because something is oversold, and do not short simply because it's overbought. Buying it on the way down is catching a falling knife with a statistics label on it.

Masoko yanaweza kubaki yamenunuliwa au kuuzwa kupita kiasi kwa muda mrefu sana huku yakiendelea kwa mwelekeo ule ule — sarafu iliyouzwa kupita kiasi inaweza kuendelea kuuzwa zaidi kupita kiasi, siku baada ya siku. e0b0161e5560.en: Jesse Livermore built his reputation on tape reading, starting as a teenager reading ticker tape in the 1890s. His core idea: the tape records actual transactions, not opinions — and actual transactions reflect real buying and selling pressure in a way a chart, updated only after the fact, cannot. Ticker tape disappeared decades ago, replaced by Level II data and order-flow software — but the underlying idea survives in those modern tools.

Tepu ya bei ilitoweka miongo iliyopita, ikibadilishwa na data ya Level II na programu ya mtiririko wa maagizo — lakini wazo la msingi linaendelea kuishi katika zana hizo za kisasa.

e8db2cfece2c.en: You bring $100 USD to the exchange counter and convert it: 100 × 20 = 2,000 pesos. You spend the week in Mexico — but your friends cover everything. You don't spend a single peso. When you fly home, you still have all 2,000 pesos, and you convert them back to dollars. But the exchange rate has moved while you were away. It's no longer 20 — it's now 1 USD = 16 MXN. To convert back: 2,000 ÷ 16 = $125 USD. You left with $100. You came back with $125. You made $25 — without spending a cent, without working, and without any plan to trade at all. It happened purely because the exchange rate moved in your favor while you held pesos.
e8db2cfece2c.sw: Unaleta $100 USD kwenye kaunta ya ubadilishaji na kuzibadilisha: 100 × 20 = peso 2,000. Unatumia wiki nzima Mexico — lakini marafiki zako wanalipia kila kitu. Hutumii hata peso moja. Unaporudi nyumbani kwa ndege, bado una peso zote 2,000, na unazibadilisha tena kuwa dola. Lakini kiwango cha ubadilishaji kimesogea ulipokuwa mbali. Si tena 20 — sasa ni 1 USD = 16 MXN. Kubadilisha tena: 2,000 ÷ 16 = $125 USD. Uliondoka na $100. Umerudi na $125. Umepata $25 — bila kutumia senti moja, bila kufanya kazi, na bila mpango wowote wa kufanya biashara kabisa. Ilitokea kwa sababu tu kiwango cha ubadilishaji kilisogea kwa manufaa yako ulipokuwa unashikilia peso.

eeb0470e0bbe.en: A 4-period SMA on a daily chart, with closes of 10, 11, 12, 14: the average is (10+11+12+14) ÷ 4 = 11.75. Next day the price drops to 9. The window slides: the oldest value (10) drops out, the new close (9) enters, and the new average is (11+12+14+9) ÷ 4 = 11.50. That sliding window is the entire mechanism — the average "moves" because its data window moves.
eeb0470e0bbe.sw: SMA ya vipindi 4 kwenye chati ya kila siku, yenye bei za kufunga za 10, 11, 12, 14: wastani ni (10+11+12+14) ÷ 4 = 11.75. Siku inayofuata bei inashuka hadi 9. Dirisha linateleza: thamani ya zamani zaidi (10) inatoka, bei mpya ya kufunga (9) inaingia, na wastani mpya ni (11+12+14+9) ÷ 4 = 11.50. Dirisha hilo linaloteleza ndio utaratibu mzima — wastani "unasogea" kwa sababu dirisha lake la data linasogea.

f2ac0cf0bbe3.sw: Njia ya kubadilishana (inayokubalika kwa upana katika biashara), hifadhi ya thamani (inashikilia thamani yake kwa muda ili uweze kuiweka akiba), na kipimo cha hesabu (kipimo cha pamoja cha kulinganisha thamani ya vitu tofauti sana — ng'ombe ana thamani ya kuku wangapi?).

f2aeb872ed85.en: Borrowed buying power that lets a trader control a position much larger than their own capital alone would allow, expressed as a ratio (e.g., 50:1).
f2aeb872ed85.sw: Uwezo wa kununua uliokopwa unaomruhusu mfanyabiashara kudhibiti nafasi kubwa zaidi kuliko mtaji wake mwenyewe ungeruhusu, ukielezwa kama uwiano (mfano, 50:1).

f3285a77dd2d.en: A statistical measure of how spread out values are around their average. The more volatile the prices, the larger the standard deviation — so the bands automatically widen in volatile markets and tighten in calm ones.
f3285a77dd2d.sw: Kipimo cha kitakwimu cha jinsi thamani zilivyotawanyika kuzunguka wastani wao. Kadri bei zinavyokuwa na mtikisiko zaidi, ndivyo mkengeuko sanifu unavyokuwa mkubwa zaidi — hivyo kanda hupanuka kiotomatiki katika masoko yenye mtikisiko na kubana katika yaliyo tulivu.

f341df7e616d.en: True or False: a strict gold standard makes it easier for a government to fight a recession.
f341df7e616d.sw: Kweli au Uongo: kiwango kikali cha dhahabu hurahisisha serikali kupambana na mdororo wa uchumi.

f36fd5e2d039.en: As you look at any pair or liquidity claim, ask yourself: is a "most traded" or "most liquid" claim backed by a specific, current, named source — or just stated as common knowledge? For an unfamiliar pair, does it include USD, and if so is the other side a major or an emerging currency? If there's no USD at all, it's a minor/cross pair. And remember that rankings change over time — treat any specific ranking as a snapshot, not a permanent fact.
f36fd5e2d039.sw: Unapotazama jozi lolote au dai lolote la ukwasi, jiulize: je, dai la "linalofanyiwa biashara zaidi" au "lenye ukwasi zaidi" linaungwa mkono na chanzo mahususi, cha sasa, kilichotajwa — au limetamkwa tu kama maarifa ya kawaida? Kwa jozi lisilofahamika, je, linajumuisha USD, na kama ndiyo, je, upande mwingine ni sarafu kuu au inayoibukia? Kama hakuna USD kabisa, ni jozi ndogo/la kuvuka. Na kumbuka madaraja hubadilika kwa muda — chukulia daraja lolote mahususi kama picha ya wakati, si ukweli wa kudumu.

f6362c968873.sw: Mfumuko wa bei unaotokana na mahitaji kukua kwa kasi zaidi kuliko ugavi.

f658f990dc86.en: Search any chart pattern's "success rate" and you'll find numbers like "70% for head-and-shoulders" or "88% for a double bottom." These trace back overwhelmingly to one source: Thomas Bulkowski, a private investor who published his own backtested statistics in books and on a personal website — not peer-reviewed, not independently replicated, and by his own data, not stable across time (failure rates nearly doubled between the bullish 1990s and the more volatile 2000s).
f658f990dc86.sw: Tafuta "kiwango cha mafanikio" cha mtindo wowote wa chati na utapata namba kama "70% kwa head-and-shoulders" au "88% kwa double bottom." Hizi zinarudi kwa wingi mkubwa kwenye chanzo kimoja: Thomas Bulkowski, mwekezaji binafsi aliyechapisha takwimu zake mwenyewe za majaribio ya nyuma katika vitabu na kwenye tovuti binafsi — hazikukaguliwa na wenzake, hazikurudiwa kwa kujitegemea, na kwa mujibu wa data yake mwenyewe, si thabiti kwa muda (viwango vya kushindwa vilikaribia kuongezeka mara mbili kati ya miaka ya 1990 ya kupanda na miaka ya 2000 yenye mtikisiko zaidi).

f67a45bd5ee6.en: Because currencies float — their values set by supply and demand, not fixed to gold or to each other — exchange rates are never still. They move constantly, sometimes by the minute.
f67a45bd5ee6.sw: Kwa sababu sarafu huelea — thamani zao zikiwekwa na ugavi na mahitaji, si kufungwa kwenye dhahabu au kwa kila mmoja — viwango vya ubadilishaji havitulii kamwe. Vinasogea kila wakati, wakati mwingine kwa dakika.

f6b69d157004.en: The price at which you actually open a position.
f6b69d157004.sw: Bei ambayo kwayo unafungua nafasi hasa.

f6c1c9bfcd4f.en: A paper document promising the holder can redeem it for a real asset — in this case gold — on demand. Merchant receipts like this existed in China as early as the 7th century; goldsmiths in 17th-century England ran a very similar system.
f6c1c9bfcd4f.sw: Hati ya karatasi inayoahidi kwamba mwenye nayo anaweza kuikomboa kwa mali halisi — katika kesi hii dhahabu — anapotaka. Risiti za wafanyabiashara kama hizi zilikuwepo China mapema kama karne ya 7; wahunzi wa dhahabu katika Uingereza ya karne ya 17 waliendesha mfumo unaofanana sana.

f6cf7a718b10.en: In prisoner-of-war camps during the Second World War, cigarettes functioned as real, working currency — divisible, portable, and valued by everyone (even non-smokers) because everyone knew everyone else would accept them. Prices were quoted "in cigarettes," debts were tracked in cigarettes, and the camp's money supply rose and fell with Red Cross parcel deliveries. This is a real, documented case (R.A. Radford's 1945 account of a WWII POW camp economy) — and it's the cleanest proof that money is about trust and function, not what it's made of.
f6cf7a718b10.sw: Katika kambi za wafungwa wa vita wakati wa Vita vya Pili vya Dunia, sigara zilifanya kazi kama sarafu halisi inayofanya kazi — zinazoweza kugawanywa, kubebeka, na kuthaminiwa na kila mtu (hata wasiovuta) kwa sababu kila mtu alijua kwamba kila mtu mwingine angezikubali. Bei zilinukuliwa "kwa sigara," madeni yalifuatiliwa kwa sigara, na kiasi cha pesa cha kambi kilipanda na kushuka kulingana na uwasilishaji wa vifurushi vya Msalaba Mwekundu. Hii ni kesi halisi iliyorekodiwa (maelezo ya R.A. Radford ya mwaka 1945 kuhusu uchumi wa kambi ya wafungwa wa Vita vya Pili vya Dunia) — na ndio uthibitisho ulio wazi zaidi kwamba pesa inahusu imani na kazi, si kile iliyotengenezwa nacho.

f6f1642fcc79.en: The possibility a decision doesn't go as intended, exposing you to loss.
f6f1642fcc79.sw: Uwezekano kwamba uamuzi hauendi kama ulivyokusudiwa, ukikuweka wazi kwa hasara.

f6f81c6b8890.en: This worked for a while — countries could hold U.S. dollars as reserves instead of physically shipping gold, making cross-border trade faster and cheaper. But a structural problem was building underneath it.
f6f81c6b8890.sw: Hii ilifanya kazi kwa muda — nchi zingeweza kushikilia dola za Marekani kama akiba badala ya kusafirisha dhahabu kimwili, na kufanya biashara ya kuvuka mipaka iwe ya haraka na ya bei nafuu zaidi. Lakini tatizo la kimuundo lilikuwa likijengeka chini yake.

f72b0938a865.en: True or False: in a short position, your stop-loss is placed below your entry price.
f72b0938a865.sw: Kweli au Uongo: katika nafasi ya short, stop-loss yako inawekwa chini ya bei yako ya kuingia.

f77dd70be86a.en: With 50:1 leverage, the required margin is 1/50 = 2% of the position size. To open a $50,000 EUR/USD position, you'd need $1,000 of your own capital as margin — the broker effectively fronts the remaining $49,000 of exposure.
f77dd70be86a.sw: Kwa leverage ya 50:1, margin inayohitajika ni 1/50 = 2% ya ukubwa wa nafasi. Kufungua nafasi ya EUR/USD ya $50,000, ungehitaji $1,000 ya mtaji wako mwenyewe kama margin — broker kwa hakika hutanguliza uwazi uliobaki wa $49,000.

f78a19f9018f.sw: Jozi yenye ukwasi mkubwa zaidi sokoni

f7b8ca20a8a7.en: The series 0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 21... where each number is the sum of the previous two. Dividing a number by its successor converges to ≈0.618 — the "golden ratio" relationship; dividing by the number two positions later gives ≈0.382, and three later ≈0.236.
f7b8ca20a8a7.sw: Mfululizo 0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 21... ambapo kila namba ni jumla ya mbili zilizotangulia. Kugawanya namba kwa inayoifuata huungana kuelekea ≈0.618 — uhusiano wa "uwiano wa dhahabu"; kugawanya kwa namba iliyo nafasi mbili baadaye hutoa ≈0.382, na tatu baadaye ≈0.236.

f7c96d70bb28.en: A stop-loss that automatically moves with the price as a trade becomes more profitable, locking in gains without requiring you to manually adjust it.
f7c96d70bb28.sw: Stop-loss inayosogea kiotomatiki pamoja na bei biashara inapopata faida zaidi, ikihifadhi faida bila kukuhitaji uirekebishe kwa mkono.

f7d0b4be96af.en: Calculating exactly how much of a currency to buy or sell in a trade, based on your account size, your risk tolerance, and your stop-loss distance.
f7d0b4be96af.sw: Kukokotoa hasa kiasi gani cha sarafu cha kununua au kuuza katika biashara, kwa msingi wa ukubwa wa akaunti yako, uvumilivu wako wa hatari, na umbali wa stop-loss yako.

f7d0d1b85997.en: The standard unit for measuring a price move in most currency pairs. For most pairs, one pip is the fourth decimal place (0.0001).
f7d0d1b85997.sw: Kipimo sanifu cha kupima msogeo wa bei katika jozi nyingi za sarafu. Kwa jozi nyingi, pip moja ni nafasi ya nne ya desimali (0.0001).

f802fb679600.en: On August 15, 1971, President Nixon announced the U.S. would suspend the dollar's convertibility into gold — "closing the gold window." What was framed as temporary turned out to be permanent. A brief patch (the Smithsonian Agreement, December 1971) failed, and by 1973 major currencies had abandoned fixed pegs entirely.
f802fb679600.sw: Tarehe 15 Agosti 1971, Rais Nixon alitangaza kwamba Marekani ingesimamisha ubadilishaji wa dola kuwa dhahabu — "kufunga dirisha la dhahabu." Kilichowasilishwa kama cha muda kiligeuka kuwa cha kudumu. Kiraka cha muda mfupi (Makubaliano ya Smithsonian, Desemba 1971) kilishindwa, na kufikia mwaka 1973 sarafu kuu zilikuwa zimeacha vifungo thabiti kabisa.

f96dbb4dd373.en: In late 2021, U.S. inflation ran notably higher than Eurozone inflation. The textbook expectation was a weaker dollar. Instead, the dollar traded near a 16-month high against the euro — fears of renewed European COVID lockdowns outweighed the inflation differential. The relationship wasn't wrong; it was overridden.
f96dbb4dd373.sw: Mwishoni mwa mwaka 2021, mfumuko wa bei wa Marekani ulikuwa juu zaidi kwa kiasi kikubwa kuliko wa Eneo la Euro. Matarajio ya kitabu yalikuwa dola dhaifu. Badala yake, dola ilifanyiwa biashara karibu na kiwango cha juu zaidi cha miezi 16 dhidi ya euro — hofu ya kufungwa upya kwa Ulaya kwa sababu ya COVID zilizidi tofauti ya mfumuko wa bei. Uhusiano haukuwa batili; ulizidiwa nguvu tu.

f9ae928b6083.en: Forex: central banks fight high inflation by raising interest rates, which tends to attract foreign capital and strengthen a currency.
f9ae928b6083.sw: Forex: benki kuu hupambana na mfumuko mkubwa wa bei kwa kupandisha viwango vya riba, jambo linaloelekea kuvutia mtaji wa kigeni na kuimarisha sarafu.

f9e894b91748.sw: Fomula ya kukokotoa sehemu bora kihisabati ya mtaji ya kuhatarisha katika dau au biashara, ili kuongeza ukuaji wa muda mrefu, iliyoendelezwa na John L. Kelly Jr. katika Bell Labs mwaka 1956.

fa650a0b1178.sw: Data ile ile kama chati ya vipau, ikiwa na mwili wenye rangi kwa usomaji wa haraka wa kuona.

fac8a5a9457d.en: Correct — MACD is built from moving averages and measures their convergence/divergence, the same underlying event as a crossover, just presented differently. No indicator computed from price can contain information price doesn't.
fac8a5a9457d.sw: Sahihi — MACD imejengwa kutoka wastani unaosogea na hupima muunganiko/utengano wao, tukio lile lile la msingi kama mkatizo, likiwasilishwa tofauti tu. Hakuna kiashiria kinachokokotolewa kutoka bei kinachoweza kuwa na taarifa ambayo bei haina.

fe8e7a33b4a0.en: Real, current spread data (2026) gives a useful sense of scale. On EUR/USD — the most liquid pair in the world — the industry-average spread across retail brokers sits around 0.88 pips on a standard, commission-free account, working out to roughly $8.80 per standard lot round-trip. On "raw" or ECN-style accounts, the quoted spread often drops close to 0.0–0.2 pips, but the broker charges a separate commission (typically $3–7 per lot round-trip) instead — the total cost usually lands in a similar range either way, just structured differently.
fe8e7a33b4a0.sw: Data halisi ya sasa ya spread (2026) inatoa hisia ya manufaa ya ukubwa. Kwenye EUR/USD — jozi lenye ukwasi mkubwa zaidi duniani — spread ya wastani wa sekta katika mabroker wa rejareja iko karibu pip 0.88 kwenye akaunti sanifu isiyo na kamisheni, ikitokea kuwa takriban $8.80 kwa lot sanifu ya kwenda na kurudi. Kwenye akaunti za "raw" au za mtindo wa ECN, spread inayonukuliwa mara nyingi hushuka karibu na pip 0.0–0.2, lakini broker hutoza kamisheni tofauti (kwa kawaida $3–7 kwa lot ya kwenda na kurudi) badala yake — gharama ya jumla kwa kawaida hufikia kiwango kinachofanana kwa vyovyote vile, ikiwa imepangwa tofauti tu.

ff246795b616.en: A position that profits if the price goes down. You're effectively selling now, expecting to buy back later at a lower price.
ff246795b616.sw: Nafasi inayopata faida kama bei itashuka. Kwa hakika unauza sasa, ukitarajia kununua tena baadaye kwa bei ya chini zaidi.

ff3e701a7507.en: Correct — their landmark finding was that a positive spread emerges even at zero expected profit, purely from the need to protect against adverse selection. Real-world spreads also reflect order-processing costs and inventory risk, not profit motive alone.
ff3e701a7507.sw: Sahihi — tokeo lao muhimu lilikuwa kwamba spread chanya hujitokeza hata kwa faida sifuri inayotarajiwa, kutokana tu na hitaji la kujilinda dhidi ya uteuzi mbaya. Spread za dunia halisi pia huakisi gharama za kushughulikia maagizo na hatari ya hifadhi, si lengo la faida peke yake.

ffcf0583bffe.en: You hold a position with a take-profit limit order at one price and a stop-loss order at another. Whichever level price reaches first executes; the other order is automatically removed. You don't have to manually cancel anything or monitor the position constantly.
ffcf0583bffe.sw: Unashikilia nafasi yenye agizo la kikomo la take-profit kwa bei moja na agizo la stop-loss kwa nyingine. Kiwango chochote ambacho bei itakifikia kwanza hutekelezwa; agizo lingine huondolewa kiotomatiki. Huhitaji kufuta chochote kwa mkono wala kufuatilia nafasi kila mara.
